title: Dhegaha hore — dhawaaqyada Ingiriisiga
description: Isku dar dhawaaqyo yaryar oo Ingiriisi ah oo ka samee eray — weli xaraf ma jiro.

[OBJECTIVE]

[LEARN]

[DRILL]
- c ... a ... t
- cat
- s ... u ... n
- sun

[VOCAB]
- cat | bisad | c-a-t 🐱
- sun | qorrax | s-u-n ☀️

[EXAMPLE]
- Dhegayso robotka: s ... u ... n
- Ku celi si tartiib ah: s - u - n
- Hadda hal mar dheh: sun ☀️

[QUIZ]
q: Dhegayso: c ... a ... t. Kee baa erayga ah?
a: cat 🐱 *
a: sun ☀️
why: c-a-t oo la isku daray waa cat, oo macnihiisu yahay bisad.

[PRACTICE]
- Waalidkaa ha yidhaahdo s ... u ... n, adna dheh: sun.
- Tus sawir bisad ah oo dheh: cat.

[GOALS]
- Maanta waxaan bartay in erayga Ingiriisigu ka samaysan yahay dhawaaqyo yaryar.
- Waxaan awoodaa inaan dhawaaqyada isku daro: c-a-t waa cat.

[PARENT]
Daqiiqad kaliya. Riix badhanka dhegaysiga, ka dibna adiga iyo ilmuhu ku wada celiya dhawaaqyada.

title: Hello iyo Goodbye
description: Labada eray ee salaanta — waa la maqlaa oo la dhahaa, weli lama akhriyo.

- Qolka ka bax oo dheh: Goodbye!

a: Hello! *

[PARENT]

title: Nidaamka jumladda: yaa, waa maxay, maxaa
description: Ingiriisiga falku wuxuu ku jiraa dhexda; Af Soomaali wuxuu ku jiraa dhammaadka.
content:
[REVIEW]
- (Sheeko) Sheekadii Hodan, muxuu aabbihiis ka soo iibsaday dukaanka?
- (Dhawaaq) Erayga milk waa immisa dhawaaq?
- (Eray qarsoodi) Erayga they macnihiisu waa maxay?
- (Erey-bixin) Geela Ingiriisiga waxaa loo yaqaan?

[HOOK]
Af Soomaali waxaad dhahdaa: Hodan shaah bay cabtay. Erayga cabtay wuxuu ku jiraa dhammaadka. Ingiriisiga isla jumladdaas waa: Hodan drank tea. Falku wuxuu u guuray dhexda. Haddaad Ingiriisi ku dhahdo Hodan tea drank, waa la fahmi doonaa laakiin qof Ingiriisi ahi weligiis sidaas ma dhaho.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad ku dhisi doontaa jumlad Ingiriisi ah nidaamka saxda ah: yaa - falka - maxaa.

[LEARN]
Jumlad Ingiriisi ah oo caadi ah waxay leedahay saddex qaybood, mar walbana isku nidaam bay ku socdaan:
1. YAA (subject) — qofka ama shayga falka sameynaya: Hodan, my brother, the cat.
2. FALKA (verb) — waxa la sameynayo: drinks, eats, reads, sees.
3. MAXAA (object) — waxa la sameynayo: tea, rice, a book.
Qaanuunka: YAA - FALKA - MAXAA. Mar walba.
Af Soomaali waa: YAA - MAXAA - FALKA. Sidaas darteed marka aad Ingiriisi ku hadlayso, waa inaad falka soo hor-mariso.

[EXAMPLE]
- Af Soomaali: Cabdi bariis buu cunay.
- Kala saar: Cabdi (yaa) / bariis (maxaa) / cunay (falka).
- Ingiriisi u beddel: Cabdi (yaa) ... ate (falka) ... rice (maxaa).
- Jumladda: Cabdi ate rice.

[EXAMPLE]
- Af Soomaali: Hooyo canjeero bay samaysay.
- Kala saar: Hooyo (yaa) / canjeero (maxaa) / samaysay (falka).
- Ingiriisi: Mum made canjeero.

[DRILL]
- I read a book.
- She drinks tea.
- My brother eats rice.
- The cat sees a bird.

[QUIZ]
q: Middee baa jumlad Ingiriisi ah oo sax ah?
a: My sister reads a book. *
a: My sister a book reads.
why: Ingiriisiga falku (reads) wuxuu ku jiraa dhexda, ka hor shayga.

[QUIZ]
q: Jumladda Cabdi drinks tea, kee baa ah falka?
a: drinks *
a: tea
why: drinks waa waxa la sameynayo — waa falka.

[CHECK]
q: Af Soomaali: Maryan hilib bay cuntay. Ingiriisi ku dheh.
a: Maryan ate meat. Falka (ate) wuxuu u guuraa dhexda.

[CHECK]
q: Maxaa qaanuun ah oo Ingiriisiga jumladdiisa ka duwan tan Af Soomaaliga?
a: Ingiriisiga falku wuxuu ku jiraa dhexda (yaa - falka - maxaa); Af Soomaali wuxuu ku jiraa dhammaadka (yaa - maxaa - falka).

[PRACTICE]
- Saddex jumlad oo Soomaali ah qor, kadibna mid kasta Ingiriisi u beddel adigoo nidaamka wax ku beddelaya.
- Waalidkaa u sheeg saddex shay oo maanta aad samaysay, Ingiriisi ahaan: I ate... I read... I saw...

[GOALS]
- Maanta waxaan bartay in jumladda Ingiriisigu tahay yaa - falka - maxaa.
- Waxaan ogahay in Af Soomaali falku dhammaadka ku jiro, taasina waa sababta khaladku u dhaco.

[PARENT]
Daqiiqad kaliya. Ilmuhu ha kuu sheego saddex jumladood oo Soomaali ah, adna weydii: falka meeye?

title: a, an iyo the
description: Af Soomaali ma laha a; taasina waa khaladka ugu badan ee soo wajaha ardayda.
content:
[REVIEW]
- (Nidaam) Jumladda Ingiriisiga falku xaggee buu ku jiraa?
- (Erey-bixin) Sidee baad u dhahdaa: kani waa walaalkay (wiil)?
- (Dhawaaq) Sidee loogu dhawaaqaa erayga book?
- (Eray qarsoodi) Erayga was macnihiisu waa maxay?

[HOOK]
Af Soomaali waxaad dhahdaa: shimbir (shimbir kasta) iyo shimbirta (tii aan labadeennuba naqaan). Farqiga waxaa muujiya ta dhammaadka. Ingiriisiga farqigaas waxaa muujiya eray yar oo hor yaal: a bird iyo the bird. Waa isla fikradda — laakiin meel kale ayay ku qoran tahay.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad dooran doontaa a, an, the, ama waxba, adigoo sababta sheegaya.

[LEARN]
Afar dooro ayaa jira:
1. a — mid ka mid ah wax badan, markii ugu horreysay ee la sheego: I saw a bird.
2. an — isla a, laakiin marka eraygu ku bilowdo dhawaaq shaqal ah: an apple, an egg, an arm. Waa fududeynta afka oo keliya.
3. the — markii labadeenna aan ognahay midkee: The bird is on the tree. (Tii aan hore u sheegnay.)
4. Waxba — marka la hadlayo si guud oo wadar ah: I like books. Camels are big. Halkan a lama isticmaalo.
Qaanuunka lagu xasuusto: markii KOOWAAD a; markii LABAAD the.

[EXAMPLE]
- I saw a cat. (markii koowaad — mid ka mid ah bisadaha)
- The cat was black. (hadda labadeennuba waan ognahay tee)
- I have got an egg. (egg wuxuu ku bilaabmaa dhawaaq shaqal ah)
- I like eggs. (si guud — waxba)

[DRILL]
- a book, a car, a goat
- an apple, an arm, an egg
- the book, the car, the goat
- I saw a camel. The camel was big.

[QUIZ]
q: Buuxi: I have got ___ apple.
a: an *
a: a
why: apple wuxuu ku bilaabmaa dhawaaq shaqal ah, sidaas darteed an ayaa la isticmaalaa.

[QUIZ]
q: I saw ___ goat. ___ goat was white. Buuxi labada meelood.
a: a ... The *
a: The ... a
why: Markii koowaad a (mid ka mid ah rida).

[CHECK]
q: Af Soomaali shimbir iyo shimbirta sidee ay ugu dhigmaan a bird iyo the bird?
a: shimbir = a bird (mid ka mid ah); shimbirta = the bird (tii la yaqaan). Soomaaligu dhammaadka ayuu ku muujiyaa, Ingiriisiguna hore.

[CHECK]
q: Sax ma tahay: I like a books?
a: Maya. Marka si guud loo hadlayo waxba lama isticmaalo: I like books.

[PRACTICE]
- Shan shay oo qolka ku jira tilmaan oo dheh: This is a...
- Kadib mar kale tilmaan oo dheh: The... is here.

[GOALS]
- Maanta waxaan bartay in a la isticmaalo markii koowaad, the-na markii labaad.
- Maanta waxaan bartay in an la isticmaalo ka hor dhawaaq shaqal ah.
- Waxaan ogahay in Af Soomaali fikraddan dhammaadka erayga ku muujiyo.

[PARENT]
Daqiiqad kaliya. Ilmuhu shay ha tilmaamo oo ha dhaho: This is a cup.

title: Wadarta: -s, -es iyo -ies
description: Saddex qaanuun oo Ingiriisiga wax badan lagu sameeyo.
content:
[REVIEW]
- (Maqaal) Goorma ayaad isticmaashaa an halkii a?
- (Nidaam) Jumladda My brother eats rice, kee baa falka?
- (Dhawaaq) Erayga stop sidee loo bilaabaa?
- (Erey-bixin) Sidee baad u dhahdaa: waxaan leeyahay laba gacmood?

Af Soomaali buug wadarkiisu waa buugaag — erayga dhexdiisa ayaa isbeddelay. Ingiriisiga qaanuunku waa ka fudud yahay: badanaa hal xaraf oo dhammaadka lagu daro. one book, two books.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad wadar ka dhigi doontaa magacyada Ingiriisiga adigoo raacaya saddex qaanuun.

[LEARN]
QAANUUN 1 — ku dar s. Kani waa kan caadiga ah: book - books, car - cars, goat - goats, hand - hands.
QAANUUN 2 — ku dar es marka eraygu ku dhammaado s, x, ch, sh ama ss: bus - buses, box - boxes, dish - dishes, glass - glasses. Sababta: s keliya lama dhawaaqi karo kadib dhawaaqyadaas.
QAANUUN 3 — haddii eraygu ku dhammaado shibbane iyo y, y beddel oo ku dar ies: baby - babies, city - cities, story - stories.
Tirinta: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Kani waa hees la celiyo, mana aha toban shay oo maanta la xafidayo.

[EXAMPLE]
- one book — two books (Qaanuun 1)
- one box — two boxes (Qaanuun 2, waayo x)
- one baby — two babies (Qaanuun 3, waayo shibbane + y)
- one camel — three camels (Qaanuun 1)

[DRILL]
- book, books
- box, boxes
- baby, babies
- goat, goats
- dish, dishes

[QUIZ]
q: Erayga box wadarkiisu waa?
a: boxes *
a: boxs
why: box wuxuu ku dhammaadaa x, sidaas darteed es ayaa la daraa.

[QUIZ]
q: Erayga city wadarkiisu waa?
a: cities *
a: citys
why: Shibbane (t) kadibna y — sidaas darteed y waa la beddelaa oo ies ayaa la daraa: cities.

[CHECK]
q: Sheeg saddexda qaanuun ee wadarta, mid walbana tusaale sii.
a: 1) ku dar s: cars. 2) ku dar es kadib s, x, ch, sh: buses. 3) shibbane + y wuxuu noqdaa ies: babies.

[CHECK]
q: Maxay tahay wadarka erayga dish?
a: dishes — waayo wuxuu ku dhammaadaa sh, sidaas darteed es baa la daraa.

[PRACTICE]
- Guriga ka tiri: two cups, three books, four boxes.
- Shan eray qor, wadarkoodana ku ag qor.

[GOALS]
- Maanta waxaan bartay saddexda qaanuun ee wadarta Ingiriisiga.
- Waxaan ogahay in Ingiriisigu wadarka dhammaadka ku sameeyo, Soomaaligu mararka qaar dhexda ka beddelo.

[PARENT]
Daqiiqad kaliya. Ilmuhu wax guriga jira ha tiriyo Ingiriisi: two cups, three spoons, four boxes.

a: foots

q: Wadarka erayga child waa?
a: children *
a: childs
why: child wuxuu noqdaa children — waa mid ka mid ah wadarrada ugu duwan Ingiriisiga.

q: Sheeg shanta lammaane ee maanta la baray.
a: man/men, woman/women, child/children, foot/feet, tooth/teeth.

[CHECK]

Dheh: I play football. Hadda dheh: My brother plays football. Falkii wuxuu qaatay s. Waa hal xaraf oo yar, laakiin waa xarafka ugu badan ee lagu illoobo Ingiriisiga.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad isticmaali doontaa waqtiga caadiga ah, adigoo s ku daraya marka la hadlayo he, she ama it.

[LEARN]
Waqtiga caadiga ah waxaa loo isticmaalaa waxa mar walba ama badanaa dhaca: waxaan cunaa, waxaan tagaa.
Qaanuunka: I, you, we, they - falka oo caadi ah. He, she, it - falka + s.
I play. You play. We play. They play.
He plays. She plays. It plays.
Diidmada:
I do not play. (I don't play.)
He does not play. (He doesn't play.)
Ogow: marka does la isticmaalo, s-tii falka waa laga qaadaa — doesn't play, ma aha doesn't plays. Hal s oo keliya ayaa jumladda ku jira.

[EXAMPLE]
- I read a book every day.
- My sister reads a book every day.
- We go to school.
- He goes to school. (go + es, waayo wuxuu ku dhammaadaa o)
- I do not eat meat. / He does not eat meat.

- I play. He plays.
- I eat. She eats.
- I go. He goes.
- I do not play. He does not play.

[QUIZ]
q: Buuxi: My brother ___ tea every morning.
a: drinks *
a: drink
why: My brother waa he, sidaas darteed falku wuxuu qaataa s: drinks.

a: She doesn't eat meat. *

why: Marka doesn't la isticmaalo, s-tii waa laga qaadaa falka.

a: My father goes to the masjid. (go wuxuu qaataa es.)

[PRACTICE]

- Waalidkaa u sheeg: My mother cooks rice. My father drinks tea.

[GOALS]

- Maanta waxaan bartay diidmada don't iyo doesn't.

[PARENT]
Daqiiqad kaliya. Weydii ilmaha: what do you do every day?

red (guduud), blue (buluug), green (cagaar), black (madow).

title: Isbarbardhig: big, bigger, biggest
description: -er, -est, than, iyo good/better/best.
content:
[REVIEW]
- (Sifo) Middee baa sax ah: a red bag mise a bag red?
- (Fal) Beddel: I eat rice. -> He ...
- (Wadar) Wadarka erayga child waa maxay?
- (Nidaam) Af Soomaali: Walaalkay buug buu akhriyay. Ingiriisi ku dheh.

[HOOK]
Geela waa weyn yahay. Ridu waa yar tahay. Laakiin sidee baad Ingiriisi ku dhahdaa geelu waa ka weyn yahay rida? Hal xaraf ayaa kugu filan: er.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad isbarbardhigi doontaa laba shay iyo saddex shay adigoo isticmaalaya -er, -est iyo than.

[LEARN]
Saddex heer ayaa jira:
Heer 1 — sifada oo keliya: big.
Heer 2 — laba la isbarbar dhigo: bigger + than. A camel is bigger than a goat.
Heer 3 — mid ka sarreeya dhammaan: the biggest. The camel is the biggest.
Qaanuunno yaryar:
- Haddii sifadu ku dhammaato shibbane keliya kadib shaqal gaaban, shibbanaha waa la labanlaabaa: big - bigger - biggest; hot - hotter - hottest.
- Haddii ay ku dhammaato y, waxay noqotaa i: happy - happier - happiest.
- Erayada dhaadheer -er ma qaataan; waxaa la isticmaalaa more: beautiful - more beautiful.
Mid ka baxsan qaanuunka: good - better - best.

[EXAMPLE]
- small - smaller - the smallest
- long - longer - the longest
- big - bigger - the biggest (b labanlaaban)
- good - better - the best (qaanuun ma raaco)
- Jumlad: My brother is taller than me. Hooyo makes the best canjeero.

[DRILL]
- big, bigger, the biggest
- small, smaller, the smallest
- good, better, the best
- A camel is bigger than a goat.

[QUIZ]
q: Buuxi: A camel is ___ than a goat.
a: bigger *
a: biggest
why: Marka laba shay la isbarbar dhigo waxaa la isticmaalaa -er iyo than.

[QUIZ]
q: Isbarbardhigga erayga good waa?
a: better *
a: gooder
why: good waa mid ka baxsan qaanuunka: good - better - best.

[CHECK]
q: Maxay tahay sababta big loo qoro bigger oo laba g leh?
a: Waayo waxay ku dhammaataa hal shibbane kadib shaqal gaaban, sidaas darteed shibbanaha waa la labanlaabaa.

[CHECK]
q: Ku dheh Ingiriisi: shaahani waa kan ugu macaan.
a: This is the best tea. (ama the sweetest tea)

[PRACTICE]
- Qoyskaaga isbarbar dheh: My brother is taller than me.
- Saddex shay oo qolka ku jira kala saar: small, smaller, the smallest.

[GOALS]
- Maanta waxaan bartay -er iyo than marka laba la isbarbar dhigo.
- Maanta waxaan bartay -est marka mid dhammaan laga sarreeyo.
- Waxaan xasuustaa in good uu noqdo better iyo best.

[PARENT]
Daqiiqad kaliya. Saddex koob oo cabbir kala duwan miiska saar.

title: Xagee buu yaal? in, on, under, behind, next to
description: Af Soomaali afar horgale oo keliya ayuu leeyahay; Ingiriisiga waa badan yihiin.
content:
[REVIEW]
- (Isbarbardhig) Buuxi: My brother is ___ (tall) than me.
- (Sifo) Ingiriisiga midabku ma qaataa s marka shaygu badan yahay?
- (Fal) Beddel: We go to school. -> She ...
- (Erey-bixin) Ridu Ingiriisiga waxaa loo yaqaan?

[HOOK]
Af Soomaali waxaad dhahdaa: buugga miiska saaran. Ingiriisiga eray gaar ah ayaa jira oo sheegaya meesha: on. Buugga miiska hoostiisa? under. Gadaashiisa? behind. Ingiriisigu wuxuu leeyahay eray meel kasta.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad sheegi doontaa meesha shay ku yaal adigoo isticmaalaya shan eray oo meel tilmaama.

[LEARN]
Shanta eray, dhammaantoodna isla su'aal bay ka jawaabaan: Where is it?
in — gudaha: The pen is in the bag.
on — dusha: The book is on the desk.
under — hoosta: The cat is under the chair.
behind — gadaasha: The ball is behind the door.
next to — dhinaca: The masjid is next to the shop.
Af Soomaali fikraddan wuxuu ku muujiyaa magacyo meelaha ah sida dhexdooda, korkiisa, hoostiisa — sidaas darteed marka hore waa in la barto in Ingiriisigu eray gaar ah isticmaalo, oo uu magaca ka hor yimaado.

[EXAMPLE]
- Where is the pen? It is in the bag.
- Where is the book? It is on the desk.
- Where is the cat? It is under the bed.
- Where is Hodan? She is behind the door.
- Where is the shop? It is next to the masjid.

[DRILL]
- in the bag
- on the desk
- under the bed
- behind the door
- next to the shop

[QUIZ]
q: Buugga miiska dushiisa ayuu yaal. Ingiriisi?
a: The book is on the desk. *
a: The book is in the desk.
why: on waa dusha; in waa gudaha.

[QUIZ]
q: Bisaddu waxay ku jirtaa sariirta hoosteeda. Buuxi: The cat is ___ the bed.
a: under *
a: behind
why: under waa hoosta; behind waa gadaasha.

[CHECK]
q: Sheeg shanta eray ee meesha tilmaama, mid walbana macnihiisa.
a: in (gudaha), on (dusha), under (hoosta), behind (gadaasha), next to (dhinaca).

[CHECK]
q: Dukaanku masaajidka dhiniciisa ayuu ku yaal. Ingiriisi ku dheh.
a: The shop is next to the masjid.

[PRACTICE]
- Shay qari, kadibna qof ha ku weydiiyo: where is it? Ku jawaab: It is under...
- Qolkaaga shan jumladood ka qor: The... is in/on/under/behind/next to the...

[GOALS]
- Maanta waxaan bartay shan eray oo meel tilmaama.
- Waxaan ka jawaabi karaa su'aasha Where is it?

[PARENT]
Daqiiqad kaliya. Shay qari guriga dhexdiisa, ilmuhuna ha raadiyo.

title: was iyo were — waqtigii hore
description: am, is, are marka ay dib u noqdaan.
content:
[REVIEW]
- (Meel) Buuxi: The cat is ___ the bed. (hoosta)
- (Isbarbardhig) Isbarbardhigga erayga good waa maxay?
- (Fal) Cidmee bay s-tu raacdaa?
- (Erey qarsoodi) Erayga was aad heerkii hore u baratay macnihiisu waa maxay?

[HOOK]
Heerkii hore waxaad baratay erayga was oo aad u aragtay eray qarsoodi. Maanta waxaad ogaanaysaa waxa uu yahay: waa is oo dib u noqday. Hadda waxaad ka hadli kartaa waxa shalay dhacay.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad ka hadli doontaa waqtigii hore adigoo isticmaalaya was iyo were.

[LEARN]
Hadda: I am, he is, she is, it is, we are, you are, they are.
Hore: I was, he was, she was, it was, we were, you were, they were.
Qaanuunka: hal shay — was. Wax badan — were.
Diidmada: was not (wasn't), were not (weren't).
I was at school. She was happy. They were at the masjid. We were not at home.
Ogow: Af Soomaali falku wax badan kuma beddelmo si joogto ah sida Ingiriisiga; sidaas darteed labadan eray waa in la dhigtaa xasuusta, kadibna wax kasta way fududaanayaan.

[EXAMPLE]
- Hadda: I am at school. -> Hore: I was at school.
- Hadda: The tea is hot. -> Hore: The tea was hot.
- Hadda: They are at the shop. -> Hore: They were at the shop.
- Diidmo: We were not late.

[DRILL]
- I was, you were, he was
- we were, they were
- She was happy.
- They were at the masjid.
- It was not hot.

[QUIZ]
q: Buuxi: Yesterday my brothers ___ at the farm.
a: were *
a: was
why: my brothers waa wax badan (they), sidaas darteed were.

[QUIZ]
q: Beddel waqtigii hore: The rice is hot.
a: The rice was hot. *
a: The rice were hot.
why: rice waa hal shay, sidaas darteed was ayaa la isticmaalaa.

[CHECK]
q: Goorma ayaan isticmaalnaa were?
a: Marka la hadlayo wax badan: we, you, they — ama magac wadar ah sida the children.

[CHECK]
q: Ku dheh Ingiriisi: shalay masaajidka ma aanan joogin.
a: I was not at the masjid yesterday. (ama I wasn't at the masjid yesterday.)

[PRACTICE]
- Saddex jumladood ka sheeg shalay: I was... We were...
- Waalidkaa weydii: where were you yesterday?

[GOALS]
- Maanta waxaan bartay in was uu yahay hal shay, were-na wax badan.
- Waxaan ka hadli karaa shalay: I was at school.

[PARENT]
Daqiiqad kaliya. Habeenkii weydii ilmaha: where were you today?

title: Waqtigii hore: -ed iyo saddexdiisa dhawaaq
description: played, walked, wanted — hal qoraal, saddex dhawaaq.
content:
[REVIEW]
- (was/were) Buuxi: The children ___ at school yesterday.
- (Wadar) Wadarka erayga box waa maxay?
- (Meel) Sheeg macnaha behind.
- (Sifo) Ingiriisiga sifadu magaca ma ka hor timaaddaa mise ka dib?

[HOOK]
Af Soomaali marka aad tidhaahdo waan ciyaaray, falka dhammaadkiisa ayaa isbeddela. Ingiriisiguna wuu isku mid yahay: play wuxuu noqdaa played. Laakiin waxaa jira wax lala yaabo — ed waxay leedahay saddex dhawaaq oo kala duwan, in kastoo mar walba isku si loo qoro.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad samayn doontaa waqtiga hore ee falalka caadiga ah, adigoo saddexda dhawaaq ee -ed kala garanaya.

[LEARN]
QAANUUNKA QORAALKA: falka ku dar ed. play - played, walk - walked, want - wanted.
- Haddii falku ku dhammaado e, d oo keliya ku dar: like - liked.
- Haddii uu ku dhammaado shibbane kadib shaqal gaaban, shibbanaha labanlaab: stop - stopped.
SADDEXDA DHAWAAQ:
1. t — kadib dhawaaq cod la'aan ah: walked (waakt), helped, cooked, washed.
2. d — kadib dhawaaq cod leh ama shaqal: played (playd), cleaned, opened.
3. id — kadib t ama d oo keliya: wanted (wontid), needed, started.
Hal qoraal, saddex dhawaaq. Dhegtaada ayaa go'aaminaysa, ma aha indhahaaga.

[EXAMPLE]
- I play football. -> Yesterday I played football. (dhawaaqa d)
- I walk to school. -> Yesterday I walked to school. (dhawaaqa t)
- I want tea. -> Yesterday I wanted tea. (dhawaaqa id)
- I stop. -> I stopped. (p labanlaaban)

[DRILL]
- played, cleaned, opened
- walked, cooked, helped
- wanted, needed, started
- Yesterday I helped my mother.

[QUIZ]
q: Erayga cooked dhammaadkiisa waa dhawaaqee?
a: t — cookt *
a: id — cookid
why: k waa dhawaaq cod la'aan ah, sidaas darteed ed wuxuu dhahaa t.

[QUIZ]
q: Waqtiga hore ee erayga stop waa?
a: stopped *
a: stoped
why: stop waxay ku dhammaataa hal shibbane kadib shaqal gaaban, sidaas darteed p waa la labanlaabaa: stopped.

[CHECK]
q: Sheeg saddexda dhawaaq ee -ed, mid walbana tusaale sii.
a: t (walked), d (played), id (wanted).

[CHECK]
q: Maxaa dhawaaqa go'aamiya — sida loo qoro mise dhawaaqa falka ka horreeya?
a: Dhawaaqa falka ka horreeya. Qoraalku mar walba waa ed.

[PRACTICE]
- Shan wax oo aad shalay samaysay qor, adigoo -ed isticmaalaya.
- Mid walba kor u dheh; dhegayso in dhammaadku yahay t, d ama id.

[GOALS]
- Maanta waxaan bartay in -ed lagu sameeyo waqtiga hore.
- Maanta waxaan bartay in -ed uu leeyahay saddex dhawaaq: t, d iyo id.

[PARENT]
Daqiiqad kaliya. Weydii ilmaha: what did you do today?

title: Falal hore oo qaanuun diida: went, saw, ate, came, took
description: Shan fal oo aad maalin kasta u baahan doonto.
content:
[REVIEW]
- (-ed) Erayga walked dhammaadkiisu waa dhawaaqee?
- (was/were) Buuxi: I ___ at the shop yesterday.
- (Wadar) Wadar aan qaanuun raacin hal tusaale sheeg.
- (Fal) Beddel: I go to school. -> He ...

[HOOK]
Shalay waxaad tagtay dugsiga. Haddii aad qaanuunka raacdo waxaad dhihi lahayd goed. Laakiin lama dhaho. Waa went. Sida wadarrada qaanuunka diida, falalka qaarkood way is beddelaan gebi ahaan.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad xasuusan doontaa shan fal oo hore oo aan -ed isticmaalin.

[LEARN]
Shantan fal waa kuwa ugu badan ee Ingiriisiga; sheeko kasta way ku jiraan. Mid kastaa gebi ahaanba wuu is beddelaa:
go - went (tag - tagay)
see - saw (arag - arkay)
eat - ate (cun - cunay)
come - came (imow - yimid)
take - took (qaad - qaatay)
Ogow: goed, seed, eated, comed iyo taked ma jiraan. Waa jawaabo macquul ah oo aan sax ahayn — waxay muujinayaan in qaanuunka la fahmay.
Diidmada: waxaa la isticmaalaa did not + falka oo caadi ah: I did not go. Ma aha I did not went.

[EXAMPLE]
- Every day I go to school. -> Yesterday I went to school.
- I see my friend. -> I saw my friend.
- I eat rice. -> I ate rice.
- She comes home. -> She came home.
- He takes the bag. -> He took the bag.
- Diidmo: I did not go to the shop.

[DRILL]
- go, went
- see, saw
- eat, ate
- come, came
- take, took
- Yesterday I went to the masjid and I saw my friend.

[QUIZ]
q: Buuxi: Yesterday I ___ to my grandmother's house.
a: went *
a: goed
why: go wuxuu noqdaa went.

[QUIZ]
q: Middee baa sax ah?
a: I did not eat meat. *
a: I did not ate meat.
why: Marka did la isticmaalo, falku wuxuu ku noqdaa qaabkiisii caadiga ahaa.

[CHECK]
q: Sheeg shanta fal iyo qaabkooda hore.
a: go/went, see/saw, eat/ate, come/came, take/took.

[CHECK]
q: Ku dheh Ingiriisi: shalay bariis baan cunay oo saaxiibkay baan arkay.
a: Yesterday I ate rice and I saw my friend.

[PRACTICE]
- Shanta lammaane warqad ku qor, maalintii hal mar akhri.
- Sheeko gaaban oo saddex jumladood ah ka sheeg shalay, adigoo laba ka mid ah falalkan isticmaalaya.

[GOALS]
- Maanta waxaan bartay shan fal oo hore oo qaanuun diida.
- Waxaan ogahay in did not kadib falku ku noqdo qaabkiisii caadiga ahaa.

[PARENT]
Daqiiqad kaliya. Casho waqtigeeda, qof kasta ha sheego hal wax oo uu maanta sameeyay Ingiriisi: I went..., I saw..., I ate...

title: Su'aalaha: what, where, who, when, why, how
description: Lixda eray ee su'aal kasta ku bilaabmaan.
content:
[REVIEW]
- (Fal hore) Buuxi: Yesterday she ___ (see) her friend.
- (-ed) Waqtiga hore ee erayga stop waa maxay?
- (Meel) Sheeg macnaha next to.
- (Maqaal) Goorma ayaan a isticmaalnaa, goormase the?

[HOOK]
Af Soomaali su'aal waxaad ku bilowdaa maxay, xagee, yaa, goorma, maxaad u, sidee. Ingiriisiga lix eray ayaa jira oo isla shaqadaas qabta, shanna ka mid ah waxay ku bilaabmaan isla laba xaraf: wh.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad weydiin doontaa oo aad ka jawaabi doontaa su'aalo isticmaalaya lixda eray ee su'aasha.

[LEARN]
what — maxay: What is this? It is a book.
where — xagee: Where is my bag? It is on the desk.
who — yaa: Who is that? That is my brother.
when — goorma: When do you go to the masjid? On Friday.
why — maxaad u: Why are you late? Because the bus was late.
how — sidee: How are you? I am fine.
QAANUUNKA JUMLADDA: erayga su'aasha waa hore, kadibna falka, kadibna qofka: Where is Hodan? Ma aha Hodan where is?
Ogow: su'aasha why jawaabteeda waxay ku bilaabantaa because.

[EXAMPLE]
- What is your name? My name is Ilyaas.
- Where do you live? I live in Hargeysa.
- Who is your teacher? My teacher is Mrs Deeqa.
- When is the lesson? On Monday.
- Why do you like rice? Because it is good.
- How old are you? I am ten years old.

[DRILL]
- What is this?
- Where is my bag?
- Who is that?
- When do you go to school?
- Why are you happy?
- How are you?

[QUIZ]
q: Waxaad rabtaa inaad ogaato meesha buuggu yaal. Su'aashee?
a: Where is the book? *
a: When is the book?
why: where waa xagee — meel.

[QUIZ]
q: Su'aasha Why are you late? jawaabteedu waxay ku bilaabantaa?
a: Because... *
a: On...
why: why waxay weydiinaysaa sababta, jawaabtuna waxay ku bilaabmaa because.

[CHECK]
q: Sheeg lixda eray ee su'aasha iyo macnahooda.
a: what (maxay), where (xagee), who (yaa), when (goorma), why (maxaad u), how (sidee).

[CHECK]
q: Nidaamka su'aasha: Where Hodan is mise Where is Hodan?
a: Where is Hodan? Falku wuxuu ka horreeyaa qofka su'aasha.

[PRACTICE]
- Waalidkaa lix su'aalood weydii, mid kasta oo eray kale ku bilaabma.
- Su'aal kasta jawaabteeda Ingiriisiga qor.

[GOALS]
- Maanta waxaan bartay lixda eray ee su'aasha.
- Waxaan ogahay in falku erayga su'aasha ka dambeeyo: Where is...?

[PARENT]

title: Su'aalaha haa iyo maya
description: Do you...? Is it...? Can you...? Have you got...? iyo codka kor u kaca.
content:

- (was/were) Goorma ayaan isticmaalnaa were?

[HOOK]
Su'aalaha qaarkood jawaabtoodu waa hal eray: haa ama maya. Ingiriisiga su'aalahaas hal calaamad ayay wadaagaan: falku wuxuu u guuraa bilowga jumladda, codkaaguna dhammaadka ayuu kor u kacaa.

[OBJECTIVE]
Maanta waxaad samayn doontaa afar nooc oo su'aal haa-maya ah, adigoo codka si sax ah u kor u qaadaya.

[LEARN]
Afarta qaab:
1. Do you...? — falalka caadiga ah: Do you like rice? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
2. Is it...? / Are they...? — is iyo are oo hore u guura: Is it hot? Yes, it is.
3. Can you...? — awoodda: Can you swim? Yes, I can.
4. Have you got...? — lahaanshaha: Have you got a pen? Yes, I have.
QAANUUNKA: jumladda caadiga ah waa You can swim. Su'aasha falkii yaraa (can, is, do, have) hore ayuu u guuraa: Can you swim?
CODKA: Af Soomaali su'aasha waxaa muujiya erayga ma iyo codka. Ingiriisiga su'aalahan codku dhammaadka ayuu KOR u kacaa. Haddii codku hoos u dhaco, waxay u ekaanaysaa war, ma aha su'aal — taasina waa sida macallimiintu mararka qaar u fahmi waayaan.

[EXAMPLE]
- You like tea. -> Do you like tea?
- It is hot. -> Is it hot?
- You can read. -> Can you read?
- You have got a sister. -> Have you got a sister?

[DRILL]

- Is it hot today?
- Can you swim?
- Have you got a pen?
- Yes, I do. No, I don't.

a: Do you like football? *
a: You like football?
why: Falka caadiga ah, su'aasha waxaa hor yimaada Do.

[QUIZ]

a: Wuu kor u kacaa *
a: Wuu hoos u dhacaa
why: Codku kor buu u kacaa.

[CHECK]

a: Yes, I do. ama No, I don't.

[PRACTICE]
